f.title: Maintain permanent contact with the National Pharmacovigilance Centre
f.statement: Members of the National Pharmacovigilance System must maintain permanent contact with the National Pharmacovigilance Centre (CNFV).

rows.actor: All members of the National Pharmacovigilance System (incl. marketing authorisation holders and pharmaceutical establishments)
rows.quote: Los miembros del Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia (SNFV) deben mantener contacto permanente con el Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Members of the National Pharmacovigilance System (SNFV) must maintain permanent contact with the National Pharmacovigilance Centre.

f.title: Designate a qualified PV responsible person resident in Ecuador, and a deputy if needed
f.statement: Pharmaceutical establishments must hold a valid operating permit and designate a pharmacovigilance responsible person who is a pharmaceutical chemist, biochemist-pharmacist or other qualified health or health-related professional registered with the competent authority, resident in Ecuador with verifiable technical qualification in pharmacovigilance; where activities require it, a deputy acting in the principal's absence must be designated.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishment (laboratories, representation houses, distributors, pharmacies) via its legal representative and technical responsible
rows.quote: Designar un responsable de Farmacovigilancia Químico Farmacéutico o Bioquímico Farmacéutico u otro profesional de la salud y/o profesional relacionado con la salud titulado y registrado ante la autoridad competente, radicado en Ecuador con calificación técnica verificable en Farmacovigilancia; y si las actividades lo requieren designar un responsable suplente de farmacovigilancia, quien actuará como delegado en ausencia del Responsable principal.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Designate a Pharmacovigilance responsible person who is a Pharmaceutical Chemist or Biochemist-Pharmacist or other health professional and/or health-related professional, qualified and registered with the competent authority, resident in Ecuador with verifiable technical qualification in Pharmacovigilance; and, if activities so require, designate a deputy pharmacovigilance responsible person, who will act as delegate in the absence of the principal Responsible person.

f.title: Notify ARCSA annually of the PV responsible person and deputy designation
f.statement: Through its legal representative the establishment must inform the CNFV annually of the designation of the pharmacovigilance responsible person and the deputy (who must meet the same profile), and communicate any update or change to this designation using the established format.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishment (laboratories, representation houses, distributors, pharmacies) via its legal representative and technical responsible
rows.quote: Informar anualmente a través de su representante legal al CNFV de la ARCSA la designación del responsable de farmacovigilancia y su suplente, quien deberá cumplir con el mismo perfil del titular. Asimismo, comunicar cualquier actualización o modificación de esta designación, conforme al formato establecido para el efecto.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Inform the CNFV of ARCSA annually, through its legal representative, of the designation of the pharmacovigilance responsible person and their deputy, who must meet the same profile as the principal. Likewise, communicate any update or modification of this designation, in accordance with the format established for this purpose.

f.title: Resource the PV responsible person and keep the PSMF ready for GPvP inspection
f.statement: The establishment must provide the pharmacovigilance responsible person with the human and material resources to perform their functions and have the Pharmacovigilance System Master File (AMSF) available to present to ARCSA during Good Pharmacovigilance Practice inspections, according to the instructions to be issued.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishment (laboratories, representation houses, distributors, pharmacies) via its legal representative and technical responsible
rows.quote: Facilitar al responsable de farmacovigilancia los recursos humanos y materiales para llevar a cabo sus funciones y disponer del Archivo Maestro del Sistema de Farmacovigilancia (AMSF) a presentar a la ARCSA durante el proceso de inspección de Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia, de conformidad con el instructivo que se elabore para el efecto.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Provide the pharmacovigilance responsible person with the human and material resources to carry out their functions and have the Pharmacovigilance System Master File (AMSF) available to present to ARCSA during the Good Pharmacovigilance Practices inspection process, in accordance with the instructions to be prepared for this purpose.

f.title: Keep SOPs and a systematic ICH-aligned case register incl. coding and duplicate detection
f.statement: The establishment must have operating procedures, files or records adequately describing pharmacovigilance functions and activities, and a systematic register for receipt, recording, validation, MedDRA coding of reaction descriptions, WHODrug coding of medicines, follow-up, duplicate detection and nullification of suspected adverse reaction, therapeutic failure and ESAVI notifications from any source, aligned with ICH guidelines.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishment (laboratories, representation houses, distributors, pharmacies) via its legal representative and technical responsible
rows.quote: Disponer de un registro sistemático para las actividades de recepción, registro, validación, codificación de las descripciones de reacciones adversas (MedDRA), codificación de los medicamentos (WHODrug), seguimiento, detección de duplicados y anulación de notificaciones de sospechas de reacciones adversas, fallas terapéuticas y ESAVI procedentes de cualquier fuente en alineamiento con los estándares descritos en las guías del ICH y sus actualizaciones.
rows.review_note: Review: SOP duty of item (4) added to the statement. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Have a systematic register for the activities of receipt, recording, validation, coding of adverse reaction descriptions (MedDRA), coding of medicines (WHODrug), follow-up, duplicate detection and nullification of notifications of suspected adverse reactions, therapeutic failures and ESAVI from any source, in alignment with the standards described in the ICH guidelines and their updates.

f.title: Notify all suspected ADRs to the CNFV via the digital platform, checking for duplicates
f.statement: The establishment must notify every suspected adverse reaction to the CNFV through the designated digital platform, according to its seriousness and within the time set by this regulation, taking into account the duplicate-identification process.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishment (laboratories, representation houses, distributors, pharmacies) via its legal representative and technical responsible
rows.quote: Notificar obligatoriamente toda sospecha de reacciones adversas al CNFV, a través de la plataforma digital establecida para el efecto según su gravedad en el tiempo estipulado en la presente normativa considerando proceso de identificación de duplicidad.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Mandatorily notify every suspected adverse reaction to the CNFV, through the digital platform established for this purpose, according to its seriousness within the time stipulated in this regulation, considering the duplicate-identification process.

f.title: Run a PV quality system, comply with GPvP and audit the PV system
f.statement: The establishment must maintain a quality assurance system for the execution, implementation, control and continuous improvement of the pharmacovigilance system, comply with Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (verified by ARCSA) and establish an audit programme to ensure the system conforms to GPvP and this regulation.
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishment (laboratories, representation houses, distributors, pharmacies) via its legal representative and technical responsible
rows.quote: Mantener un sistema de aseguramiento de la calidad para la ejecución, implementación, control y mejora continua del sistema de farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: items (8) and (11) merged into the statement (same duty family). Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Maintain a quality assurance system for the execution, implementation, control and continuous improvement of the pharmacovigilance system.

f.title: Keep a detailed register and archive of all suspected ADRs at the establishment
f.statement: The establishment must keep a detailed register and a physical or digital archive of all suspected adverse reactions, in line with Agreement No. SGPR-2019-0107 or its replacement, kept at the pharmaceutical establishment.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishment (laboratories, representation houses, distributors, pharmacies) via its legal representative and technical responsible
rows.quote: Llevar un registro detallado y mantener un sistema de archivo físico o digital de todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas, de conformidad con las especificaciones del Acuerdo No. SGPR-2019-0107 o la normativa que lo sustituya, los cuales deberán permanecer en el establecimiento farmacéutico.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Keep a detailed register and maintain a physical or digital filing system of all suspected adverse reactions, in accordance with the specifications of Agreement No. SGPR-2019-0107 or the regulation that replaces it, which shall remain at the pharmaceutical establishment.

f.title: Train establishment staff continuously in pharmacovigilance
f.statement: The establishment must continuously train its staff in pharmacovigilance and related topics according to their assigned functions.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishment (laboratories, representation houses, distributors, pharmacies) via its legal representative and technical responsible
rows.quote: Capacitar de forma continua al personal del establecimiento en materia de farmacovigilancia y temas relacionados, conforme a las funciones asignadas.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Continuously train the establishment staff in pharmacovigilance and related topics, according to the functions assigned.

f.title: Document any transfer of PV activities in a signed written agreement
f.statement: Any transfer of pharmacovigilance activities to a third party must be documented in a written agreement signed by the representatives of both parties, specifying the responsibilities assigned and the information to be exchanged.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishment (laboratories, representation houses, distributors, pharmacies) via its legal representative and technical responsible
rows.quote: Documentar toda transferencia de actividades en materia de Farmacovigilancia a un tercero mediante un acuerdo escrito, firmado por los representantes de ambas partes, en el cual se especifiquen las responsabilidades asignadas y la información a intercambiar.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Document any transfer of Pharmacovigilance activities to a third party by means of a written agreement, signed by the representatives of both parties, specifying the responsibilities assigned and the information to be exchanged.

f.title: Ensure PV data quality, integrity, traceability and confidentiality and give inspectors access
f.statement: The establishment must guarantee the quality, integrity, completeness, traceability and confidentiality of pharmacovigilance information generated or received, and facilitate access to pharmacovigilance information and documentation during ARCSA inspection, supervision or control.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishment (laboratories, representation houses, distributors, pharmacies) via its legal representative and technical responsible
rows.quote: Garantizar la calidad, integridad, completitud, trazabilidad y confidencialidad de la información de farmacovigilancia generada o recibida en el establecimiento.
rows.review_note: Review: item (14) (access during inspections) merged. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Guarantee the quality, integrity, completeness, traceability and confidentiality of the pharmacovigilance information generated or received at the establishment.

f.title: Evaluate benefit-risk continuously and inform ARCSA immediately of changes
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person of the establishment must continuously evaluate the benefit-risk balance of medicines and vaccines in the post-authorisation period and immediately inform ARCSA of any information that could change it; they must also communicate relevant changes in safety profile to ARCSA through periodic safety reports and/or RMPs.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the pharmaceutical establishment
rows.quote: Realizar una evaluación continua de la relación beneficio-riesgo de los medicamentos y vacunas durante el periodo de posautorización y comunicar de inmediato a la ARCSA cualquier información que pudiera suponer un cambio en dicha relación.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Carry out a continuous evaluation of the benefit-risk balance of medicines and vaccines during the post-authorisation period and immediately communicate to ARCSA any information that could imply a change in that balance.

f.title: Communicate medicine risks to staff, including medical and sales representatives
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person of the establishment must keep staff informed of medicine-related risks, including medical visitors and pharmaceutical sales representatives.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the pharmaceutical establishment
rows.quote: Mantener la comunicación de riesgos asociados a medicamentos al personal que trabaja en el establecimiento, incluyendo visitadores médicos y los representantes de ventas farmacéuticos.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Maintain the communication of risks associated with medicines to the staff working at the establishment, including medical visitors and pharmaceutical sales representatives.

f.title: Ensure resources for PV and answer to ARCSA for institutional non-compliance
f.statement: The legal representative must ensure the establishment has a valid operating permit and complies with health rules, ensure human, technical and administrative resources for pharmacovigilance obligations, institutionally support the PV system, and answer to ARCSA for non-compliance with the institutional obligations of this regulation, without prejudice to administrative, civil or criminal liability.

rows.actor: Legal representative of the pharmaceutical establishment
rows.quote: Asegurar la disponibilidad de recursos humanos, técnicos y administrativos necesarios para el cumplimiento de las obligaciones institucionales en materia de farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: the other legal-representative items (1, 3, 4) summarised. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Ensure the availability of the human, technical and administrative resources needed to comply with institutional obligations in pharmacovigilance.

f.title: Implement and maintain an effective GPvP-compliant PV system for the product life cycle
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders must implement, maintain and ensure the effective operation of a pharmacovigilance system in line with the Good Pharmacovigilance Practices adopted by ARCSA throughout the product life cycle, including a own or contracted pharmacovigilance unit or system with competent, experienced staff, a formally designated pharmacovigilance responsible person and deputy with an appropriate profile, and the human, technical and financial resources needed.
f.processes: Safety governance; Quality system & CAPA; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Es obligación de los Titulares de Registro Sanitario de los productos objeto de la presente normativa implementar, mantener y asegurar el funcionamiento efectivo de un sistema de farmacovigilancia, conforme a las Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia adoptadas por la ARCSA, durante todo el ciclo de vida del producto
rows.review_note: Review: organisation items (1)-(3) merged into the statement. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: It is the obligation of Marketing Authorisation Holders of the products covered by this regulation to implement, maintain and ensure the effective operation of a pharmacovigilance system, in accordance with the Good Pharmacovigilance Practices adopted by ARCSA, throughout the product life cycle

f.title: Maintain an up-to-date Pharmacovigilance System Master File
f.statement: The marketing authorisation holder must have and keep up to date the Pharmacovigilance System Master File (AMFV), according to ARCSA's instructions.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Disponer y mantener actualizado el Archivo Maestro del Sistema de Farmacovigilancia (AMFV), conforme al instructivo emitido por la ARCSA.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Have and keep updated the Pharmacovigilance System Master File (AMFV), in accordance with the instructions issued by ARCSA.

f.title: Notify all suspected ADRs, failures, ESAVI and safety issues and keep reporting during outages
f.statement: The holder must guarantee mandatory notification to the CNFV of all suspected adverse reactions, therapeutic failures, ESAVI and other safety problems within the set time limits, and ensure continuity of reporting even during system failures by using the alternative channels ARCSA provides.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Garantizar la notificación obligatoria al CNFV de todas las sospechas de RAM, FT, ESAVI y demás problemas de seguridad, conforme a los plazos establecidos. 6. Asegurar la continuidad del reporte, incluso ante fallas del sistema, utilizando los canales alternativos habilitados por la ARCSA.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Guarantee mandatory notification to the CNFV of all suspected ADRs, TFs, ESAVI and other safety problems, in accordance with the established time limits. 6. Ensure the continuity of reporting, even in the event of system failures, using the alternative channels enabled by ARCSA.

f.title: Keep traceable records of receipt, validation, coding, follow-up and closure of reports
f.statement: The holder must maintain systematic and traceable records of receipt, validation, coding (MedDRA/WHODrug), follow-up and closure of notifications, in line with ICH standards.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Mantener registros sistemáticos y trazables de recepción, validación, codificación (MedDRA / WHODrug), seguimiento y cierre de notificaciones, conforme a estándares ICH.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Maintain systematic and traceable records of receipt, validation, coding (MedDRA/WHODrug), follow-up and closure of notifications, in accordance with ICH standards.

f.title: Submit PSUR/PBRERs with benefit-risk, signal and risk minimisation content
f.statement: The holder must submit Periodic Safety Reports (IPS/PBRER) with the periodicity and scope ARCSA defines in its instructions, incorporating updated benefit-risk evaluations, signal detection and risk minimisation measures.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Presentar Informes Periódicos de Seguridad (IPS/PBRER) conforme a la periodicidad y alcance definidos por la ARCSA, en el instructivo que se disponga para el efecto. 9. Incorporar evaluaciones actualizadas de beneficio–riesgo, detección de señales y medidas de minimización de riesgos en los IPS/PBRER.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Submit Periodic Safety Reports (IPS/PBRER) in accordance with the periodicity and scope defined by ARCSA, in the instructions issued for this purpose. 9. Incorporate updated benefit-risk evaluations, signal detection and risk minimisation measures in the IPS/PBRER.

f.title: Prepare and implement risk management plans when ARCSA requires
f.statement: The holder must prepare and implement Risk Management Plans (PMR/PGR) when ARCSA requires them.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Elaborar e implementar Planes de Manejo o Gestión de Riesgos (PMR/PGR) cuando sean requeridos por la ARCSA.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Prepare and implement Risk Management Plans (PMR/PGR) when required by ARCSA.

f.title: Update leaflet, labelling and safety material for new risks or on ARCSA order
f.statement: The holder must update the package leaflet, labelling and safety material when new risks are identified or ARCSA so orders.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Actualizar prospecto, etiquetado y material de seguridad, cuando se identifiquen nuevos riesgos o cuando la ARCSA lo disponga.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Update the package leaflet, labelling and safety material when new risks are identified or when ARCSA so orders.

f.title: Communicate relevant benefit-risk changes to ARCSA promptly
f.statement: The holder must promptly communicate to ARCSA any relevant change in the product's benefit-risk balance.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Comunicar oportunamente a la ARCSA cualquier cambio relevante en la relación beneficio–riesgo del producto.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Communicate promptly to ARCSA any relevant change in the benefit-risk balance of the product.

f.title: Answer ARCSA requests on time, provide PV information and facilitate GPvP inspections
f.statement: The holder must respond to ARCSA's technical requests within the set time limits, make all pharmacovigilance information available to ARCSA when required, and allow and facilitate Good Pharmacovigilance Practice inspections.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Responder dentro de los plazos establecidos a los requerimientos técnicos de ARCSA.
rows.review_note: Review: items (15)-(16) merged into the statement. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Respond within the established time limits to ARCSA's technical requests.

f.title: Notify ARCSA of closed safety signals
f.statement: The holder must notify ARCSA of closed safety signals according to current technical criteria.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Notificar a ARCSA las señales de seguridad cerradas, conforme a los criterios técnicos vigentes.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Notify ARCSA of closed safety signals, in accordance with current technical criteria.

f.title: Maintain PV quality assurance, SOPs and periodic audits
f.statement: The holder must maintain a quality assurance system for the pharmacovigilance system, have standard operating procedures describing pharmacovigilance activities, and establish and carry out periodic audits of the pharmacovigilance system.
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Mantener un sistema de aseguramiento de la calidad del sistema de farmacovigilancia. 18. Disponer de procedimientos operativos estandarizados que describan las actividades de farmacovigilancia. 19. Establecer y ejecutar auditorías periódicas del sistema de farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Maintain a quality assurance system for the pharmacovigilance system. 18. Have standardised operating procedures describing pharmacovigilance activities. 19. Establish and carry out periodic audits of the pharmacovigilance system.

f.title: Document delegation or outsourcing while keeping final responsibility
f.statement: The holder must formally document any delegation or outsourcing, retaining final responsibility as marketing authorisation holder.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Documentar formalmente cualquier delegación o tercerización, manteniendo la responsabilidad final como Titular del Registro Sanitario.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Formally document any delegation or outsourcing, maintaining final responsibility as Marketing Authorisation Holder.

f.title: Submit post-authorisation safety study information when applicable
f.statement: The holder must submit information from post-authorisation safety studies, where applicable, according to ARCSA requirements.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Presentar información de estudios de seguridad posautorización, cuando aplique, conforme a los requerimientos establecidos por la ARCSA.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Submit information from post-authorisation safety studies, where applicable, in accordance with the requirements established by ARCSA.

f.title: Protect personal data and keep PV records complete and available
f.statement: The holder must guarantee the confidentiality and protection of personal data of patients and reporters under current regulations, and keep pharmacovigilance records organised, complete and available according to health rules and set retention periods.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: Garantizar la confidencialidad y protección de los datos personales de pacientes y notificadores, de conformidad con la normativa vigente. 23. Mantener los registros de farmacovigilancia organizados, íntegros y disponibles, conforme a la normativa sanitaria aplicable y a los plazos establecidos.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Guarantee the confidentiality and protection of the personal data of patients and reporters, in accordance with current regulations. 23. Keep pharmacovigilance records organised, complete and available, in accordance with applicable health regulations and established time limits.

f.title: Act as PV contact for ARCSA and for GPvP inspections
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person of the holder acts as the valid pharmacovigilance interlocutor with the authority and as contact point for Good Pharmacovigilance Practice inspections, and must establish and maintain the pharmacovigilance system under this regulation and GPvP.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Actuar como interlocutor válido en materia de farmacovigilancia ante la autoridad, y fungir como punto de contacto para las inspecciones de Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Act as the valid interlocutor on pharmacovigilance matters before the authority, and serve as the contact point for Good Pharmacovigilance Practices inspections.

f.title: Update the PSMF annually and provide a copy within 7 days of a CNFV request
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person must update the Pharmacovigilance System Master File annually. The CNFV may at any time request a copy from the holder, which must be delivered within at most seven (7) days of receipt of the request; the master file must be available for GPvP inspection.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: Annual update; copy within 7 days of a CNFV request
rows.quote: Mantener actualizado el archivo maestro del sistema de farmacovigilancia anualmente. El CNFV podrá requerir en cualquier momento al titular del registro sanitario una copia de este archivo, la cual deberá entregarse en el plazo máximo de siete (7) días desde la recepción del requerimiento.
rows.review_note: Review: "días" not qualified; read as calendar days. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: unit inferred, 88.
rows.quote_en: Keep the pharmacovigilance system master file updated annually. The CNFV may at any time require the marketing authorisation holder to provide a copy of this file, which shall be delivered within a maximum of seven (7) days from receipt of the request.

deadline_rule.applies_to: copy of the PSMF requested by the CNFV

f.title: Review national and international literature for suspected ADRs and safety issues
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person must review the national and international scientific literature, where appropriate, to identify suspected adverse reactions, ESAVI and other safety problems with the authorised medicines.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Revisar la bibliografía científica nacional e internacional, cuando corresponda, para identificar sospechas de reacciones adversas, ESAVI y otros problemas relacionado con la seguridad de los medicamentos autorizados.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Review the national and international scientific literature, where appropriate, to identify suspected adverse reactions, ESAVI and other problems related to the safety of the authorised medicines.

f.title: Ensure causality assessment of reports with the medical department
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person must ensure the causality assessment of ADR, ESAVI and other safety reports, in coordination with the medical department or equivalent and/or technical directorate, using the algorithms or criteria in the applicable instructions or guide.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Asegurar la evaluación de la causalidad de los reportes RAM, ESAVI y otros problemas relacionados con la seguridad de los medicamentos, en coordinación con el departamento médico o su equivalente y/o dirección técnica, utilizando los algoritmos o criterios establecidos en el instructivo o guía aplicable para el efecto.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Ensure the causality assessment of ADR reports, ESAVI and other problems related to the safety of medicines, in coordination with the medical department or its equivalent and/or technical directorate, using the algorithms or criteria established in the applicable instructions or guide for this purpose.

f.title: Share identified risks with staff, including medical and sales representatives
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person must share the risks identified for authorised medicines and vaccines with the establishment's staff, including medical visitors and sales representatives.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Socializar los riesgos identificados en los medicamentos y vacunas autorizados con el personal del establecimiento, incluidos los visitadores médicos y representantes de ventas.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Share the risks identified for the authorised medicines and vaccines with the establishment's staff, including medical visitors and sales representatives.

f.title: Notify AEs from post-marketing studies of registered products to the CNFV
f.statement: Sponsors and CROs must notify the CNFV of adverse events arising from clinical studies with products registered in Ecuador conducted under routine medical practice and/or over prolonged periods (post-marketing or post-registration studies) previously approved by the ethics committee (CEISH).

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (CRO)
rows.quote: Notificar obligatoriamente al Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia (CNFV) de la ARCSA los eventos adversos derivados de estudios clínicos con productos que cuenten con registro sanitario en el Ecuador, realizados en condiciones de práctica médica habitual y/o durante periodos prolongados, también denominados estudios de poscomercialización o posregistro, previamente aprobados por el CEISH.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Mandatorily notify the National Pharmacovigilance Centre (CNFV) of ARCSA of adverse events arising from clinical studies with products holding a sanitary registration in Ecuador, conducted under conditions of routine medical practice and/or over prolonged periods, also called post-marketing or post-registration studies, previously approved by the CEISH.

f.title: Notify ADRs for exceptional-import or donated products and keep reporting during outages
f.statement: Applicants for exceptional or donation import authorisations must notify every suspected adverse reaction, therapeutic failure and ESAVI to the CNFV through the digital platform according to seriousness and within the set time, and if the notification system fails must ensure continuity by notifying immediately through the digital means ARCSA provides or by e-mail.
f.applicability: Products imported by exception or donation

rows.actor: Applicants for import authorisation by exception or for donation
rows.quote: Notificar obligatoriamente toda sospecha de reacciones adversas, fallas terapéuticas y ESAVI al CNFV, a través de la plataforma digital establecida para el efecto según su gravedad en el tiempo estipulado en la presente normativa.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Mandatorily notify every suspected adverse reaction, therapeutic failure and ESAVI to the CNFV, through the digital platform established for this purpose, according to its seriousness within the time stipulated in this regulation.

f.title: Provide PSURs, risk minimisation, B/R information and PASS data for exceptional-import products
f.statement: Applicants for exceptional or donation imports must submit periodic safety reports and any risk minimisation measures in the RMP when ARCSA requests, communicate any new information that may affect benefit-risk, respond on time to ARCSA requests, keep PV records under Agreement SGPR-2019-0107, make all information available to ARCSA at any time, conduct and submit post-authorisation safety study information where applicable or requested, and protect the identity of reporters.
f.applicability: Products imported by exception or donation

rows.actor: Applicants for import authorisation by exception or for donation
rows.quote: Presentar Informes Periódicos de Seguridad IPS/(PBRER) y cualquier medida de minimización de riesgos implementada en el PMG/PGR cuando la Agencia lo solicite.
rows.review_note: Review: items (4)-(9) summarised (they continue after a page header). Re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement beyond the quote, 86.
rows.quote_en: Submit Periodic Safety Reports IPS/(PBRER) and any risk minimisation measure implemented in the RMP when the Agency requests it.

f.title: Report ADRs, medication errors, failures, ESAVI, off-label and occupational exposure reactions
f.statement: Adverse drug reactions, medication errors, therapeutic failures and ESAVI must be notified, as well as adverse reactions arising from use within or outside the marketing authorisation (off-label, overdose, misuse, abuse, medication errors) or from occupational exposure. Cases that do not generate adverse reactions or ESAVI must be identified and recorded in the pharmacovigilance systems and are notified to the CNFV only at its request.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders and pharmaceutical establishments
rows.quote: Aquellos que no generen reacciones adversas o ESAVI, deberán identificarse y registrarse en los sistemas de Farmacovigilancia, y solo serán notificados al CNFV por solicitud de éste.
rows.review_note: Review: first part of Art. 32 (what must be notified) summarised in the statement; quote covers the record-only rule. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Those that do not generate adverse reactions or ESAVI shall be identified and recorded in the Pharmacovigilance systems, and shall only be notified to the CNFV at its request.

f.title: Notify only valid cases with the four minimum elements
f.statement: Only valid pharmacovigilance cases are to be notified. A valid case contains at least: patient identification (age, sex, initials or contact authorisation, medical record number, date of birth, gestation period); suspect medicine (name, dose, batch, route, duration, including interacting substances or medicines); the adverse event or safety problem (clinical description); and reporter identification (name, initials, contact details).
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders and pharmaceutical establishments
rows.quote: Únicamente deberán notificar los casos válidos de farmacovigilancia. Se considera un caso válido aquel que tenga como mínimo, la siguiente información:
rows.review_note: Review: element list summarised from the bullets of Art. 33. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Only valid pharmacovigilance cases shall be notified. A valid case is considered to be one that has at least the following information:

f.title: Treat all spontaneous reports as suspected ADRs unless the reporter excludes causality
f.statement: A spontaneously notified adverse event meets the ADR definition even if the relationship is unknown or not stated; all spontaneous notifications are therefore considered suspected adverse drug reactions unless the primary source specifically states it believes the event is unrelated or that a causal relationship can be ruled out.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders and pharmaceutical establishments
rows.quote: Por lo tanto, todas las notificaciones espontáneas se consideran sospechas de reacciones adversas a medicamentos, ya que transmiten las sospechas de las fuentes primarias, a menos que la fuente primaria indique específicamente que cree que el evento no está relacionado o que se puede descartar una relación causal.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Therefore, all spontaneous notifications are considered suspected adverse drug reactions, since they convey the suspicions of the primary sources, unless the primary source specifically indicates that it believes the event is not related or that a causal relationship can be ruled out.

f.title: Notify through the ARCSA digital platform as the external instructions set out
f.statement: Notification of ADRs, therapeutic failures, ESAVI and other safety problems is made through the digital platform for pharmaceutical and health establishments, according to the current external instructions.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders
rows.quote: La notificación de las reacciones adversas a medicamentos (RAM), fallas terapéuticas (FT), evento supuestamente atribuible a la vacunación o inmunización (ESAVI) y otros problemas de seguridad relacionados con el uso de medicamentos y vacunas se realizará mediante la plataforma digital destinada para los establecimientos farmacéuticos y de salud de acuerdo al instructivo externo vigente.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Notification of adverse drug reactions (ADR), therapeutic failures (TF), events supposedly attributable to vaccination or immunisation (ESAVI) and other safety problems related to the use of medicines and vaccines shall be made through the digital platform intended for pharmaceutical and health establishments according to the current external instructions.

f.title: Notify serious suspected ADRs and ESAVI within 15 days
f.statement: When notified by pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders, all suspected serious adverse drug reactions and serious ESAVI, expected or unexpected, must be notified within at most fifteen (15) days of becoming aware of the event.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders
rows.quote: Todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas a medicamentos y ESAVI graves, esperadas o inesperadas, deberán ser notificadas en el plazo máximo de quince (15) días desde que se tenga conocimiento del evento;
rows.review_note: Review: "días" unqualified, read as calendar days; regulation does not distinguish origin. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: unit inferred, 88.
rows.quote_en: All suspected serious adverse drug reactions and serious ESAVI, expected or unexpected, shall be notified within a maximum period of fifteen (15) days from becoming aware of the event;

deadline_rule.clock_start: desde que se tenga conocimiento del evento
deadline_rule.applies_to: serious suspected ADRs and serious ESAVI, expected or unexpected (establishments and MAHs)

f.title: Notify non-serious suspected ADRs and ESAVI within 30 days
f.statement: When notified by pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders, non-serious suspected ADRs and ESAVI, expected or unexpected, must be notified within at most thirty (30) days of becoming aware of the event.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders
rows.quote: mientras que los no graves sean estos esperados o inesperados deberán ser notificados en el plazo máximo de treinta (30) días desde que se tenga conocimiento del evento; cuando estos sean notificados por los establecimientos farmacéuticos y titulares de registro sanitario.
rows.review_note: Review: unit read as calendar days. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: while non-serious ones, whether expected or unexpected, shall be notified within a maximum period of thirty (30) days from becoming aware of the event, when these are notified by pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders.

deadline_rule.clock_start: desde que se tenga conocimiento del evento
deadline_rule.applies_to: non-serious suspected ADRs and ESAVI, expected or unexpected (establishments and MAHs)

f.title: Choose a recognised causality assessment method
f.statement: For causality assessment, various methodologies may be used, such as those endorsed and disseminated by the Uppsala Monitoring Centre or those applied by a regulatory authority.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders and pharmaceutical establishments
rows.quote: Para la evaluación de causalidad, se podrán utilizar las diversas metodologías, como las avaladas y difundidas por el UMC o las aplicadas por alguna autoridad regulatoria.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: For causality assessment, the various methodologies may be used, such as those endorsed and disseminated by the UMC or those applied by any regulatory authority.

f.title: Code events with current MedDRA and products with current WHODrug
f.statement: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders (and health establishments) must code clinical manifestations, diseases and abnormal laboratory findings using the current MedDRA terminology and code medicines and vaccines using the current WHODrug dictionary.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders
rows.deadline: Mandatory use within 18 months of publication in the Registro Oficial
rows.quote: Los establecimientos de salud a través de la Comisión técnica de Farmacovigilancia, establecimientos farmacéuticos y titulares de registro sanitario deben realizar la codificación de las manifestaciones clínicas, enfermedades, hallazgos anormales de laboratorio reportados, utilizando la terminología MedDRA vigente y la codificación de los medicamentos y vacunas utilizando el diccionario WHODrug vigente.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Health establishments through the Pharmacovigilance Technical Commission, pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders must code the clinical manifestations, diseases and abnormal laboratory findings reported, using the current MedDRA terminology, and code medicines and vaccines using the current WHODrug dictionary.

f.title: Notify medication errors only when they cause an ADR with harm or death
f.statement: Medication errors are notified to the CNFV only when they are related to adverse reactions and cause harm to the patient or end in a fatal error.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders and pharmaceutical establishments
rows.quote: En el caso de los errores de medicación se notificará al CNFV únicamente los que estén relacionados con reacciones adversas y causen daño al paciente o concluyan en un error mortal.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: In the case of medication errors, only those related to adverse reactions that cause harm to the patient or end in a fatal error shall be notified to the CNFV.

f.title: Report serious unexpected reactions from post-authorisation safety studies per the instructions
f.statement: Notifications of serious unexpected adverse events or reactions detected during post-marketing and/or post-authorisation safety studies follow the current external instructions issued for this purpose.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders and sponsors of post-authorisation safety studies
rows.quote: En el caso de notificaciones de eventos adversos o reacciones adversas graves inesperadas (RAGI) detectadas durante estudios de seguridad poscomercialización y/o posautorización, se realizará según el instructivo externo vigente para el efecto.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: In the case of notifications of serious unexpected adverse events or adverse reactions (RAGI) detected during post-marketing and/or post-authorisation safety studies, this shall be done according to the current external instructions for this purpose.

f.title: Assess suspected therapeutic failures before notifying and treat them as serious
f.statement: Before notifying a suspected therapeutic failure to ARCSA, assessment tools must be applied to identify whether factors explain the insufficient response (for example adherence, dosage, product quality, clinical conditions); notification follows the current external instructions, and every therapeutic failure is classified as a serious adverse event under internationally accepted criteria, including ICH.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders and pharmaceutical establishments
rows.quote: En caso de sospecha de falla terapéutica, antes de su notificación a la ARCSA, deberán aplicarse herramientas de evaluación que permitan identificar la existencia o no de factores que expliquen la respuesta insuficiente en el paciente (por ejemplo, adherencia, posología, calidad del producto, condiciones clínicas u otros factores).
rows.review_note: Review: classification of all therapeutic failures as serious added from the last sentence of Art. 43. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: In the case of a suspected therapeutic failure, before its notification to ARCSA, evaluation tools shall be applied to identify whether or not there are factors explaining the insufficient response in the patient (for example, adherence, dosage, product quality, clinical conditions or other factors).

f.title: Carry out ARCSA risk-reduction measures and report their implementation
f.statement: After risk analysis ARCSA may order risk-reduction measures and notify the applicant or holder to carry them out; these may include safety communications to health professionals or users, updates to labelling, leaflet or SmPC, studies or surveillance activities, restriction of indications, uses or populations, change of sales category or special prescribing and dispensing conditions, suspension of distribution, marketing or import, and batch or product recall. The holder must inform ARCSA of the implementation of the actions ordered.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Safety communications; Safety labeling

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation (sanitary registration) holder
rows.quote: El titular del registro sanitario deberá informar a la ARCSA la implementación de las acciones dispuestas.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall inform ARCSA of the implementation of the actions ordered.

dates.title: ARCSA Resolution ARCSA-DE-2025-052-DASP (National PV System regulation): enters into force
dates.scope: All members of the National Pharmacovigilance System, including marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical establishments, sponsors/CROs and exceptional-import applicants; repeals Resolution ARCSA-DE-020-2016-YMIH
dates.quote: La presente normativa técnica sanitaria entrará en vigencia en el plazo de nueve (9) meses contados a partir de su publicación en el Registro Oficial.
dates.quote_en: This technical health regulation shall enter into force nine (9) months from its publication in the Official Register.
dates.timing_note: Published in Registro Oficial No. 218 on 2026-02-04 + 9 months = 2026-11-04. Signed 31 December 2025.

dates.title: ARCSA Resolution 052-2025: MedDRA and WHODrug coding mandatory
dates.scope: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders: mandatory use of current MedDRA and WHODrug
dates.quote: En el plazo de dieciocho (18) meses contados a partir de la publicación de la presente normativa en el Registro Oficial, los establecimientos farmacéuticos/titulares de registro sanitario deberán implementar el uso obligatorio de la terminología MedDRA vigente
dates.quote_en: Within eighteen (18) months from the publication of this regulation in the Official Register, pharmaceutical establishments/marketing authorisation holders shall implement the mandatory use of the current MedDRA terminology
dates.timing_note: Published in Registro Oficial No. 218 on 2026-02-04 + 18 months = 2027-08-04.
